notes.title: A Whole New Cathexis!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44927229/cea8bdb68a8d82e3d08820249b57c778c6fc1459.png[/img]

Cathexis has been completely reimagined from the ground up, and we're so excited to share our first playable preview demo with you today!

Cathexis is about escaping from a vast, living machine built by long-forgotten gods. Smash your prison by reclaiming the power of Cathexis from the Construct's machinery.

There's so much to tell you about and this is just the very start. Stay tuned for more updates soon and make sure to join us on [url=https://discord.gg/RRbf85QeMf]Discord[/url] for all the latest Cathexis news!

notes.title: First Preview Demo is LIVE!
notes.content:
We're delighted to announce that Cathexis has launched its first Public Preview Demo! This demo showcases a minimal example of the parkour puzzle gameplay loop that forms the core, moment-to-moment Cathexis experience. 

This demo release came after a lot of internal debate. On the one hand, we all want to release something polished and perfect. But if the perfect is the enemy of the good, and we wait months and months before giving YOU a chance to see the game, even in its very early state, we're missing a chance to gain vital feedback and prioritize future development with the help of your input.

So please enjoy this first glimpse of Cathexis...we CANNOT WAIT to show you more :) Join our community on [url=https://discord.gg/RRbf85QeMf]Discord[/url] and become part of this awesome journey!

- Sasha and the Syncretic Games Team

notes.title: The Journey Begins!
notes.content:
It is my tremendous honor to start updating you about development progress on Cathexis, a first-person parkour puzzle game set in a world of mysterious pillars.

Cathexis has been in concept and development for around four years, and has slowly grown from a vague idea to a playable Proof of Concept. Over the last six months, our team has scaled up to tackle full production, and I finally feel confident enough about the game and its prospects to begin to bring you along for the journey!

So to set a few expectations first: Cathexis is nowhere near an Early Access release. There are major systems to implement, content to build, and feel to land. Our small and mighty team is hard at work, but we need your help to ensure we're tackling the highest value features and steering in the right direction.

If you'd like to join our community and help us make Cathexis the best game it can possibly be:
1. Please join our [url=https://discord.gg/RRbf85QeMf]Discord[/url] to stay in touch with the Cathexis community and developers
2. Join the first closed playtest, which we're hoping to kick off in the beginning of September through Steam Playtests
3. Support us on [url=https://www.youtube.com/@syncreticgames]YouTube[/url], and on [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@syncreticgames]TikTok[/url]
4. Stay tuned to our upcoming weekly devlogs and game updates

Thank you, so excited to be on this voyage with you all!

Sasha
Founder and CEO, Syncretic Games
